name: SummerSlam
Text: Can only be played when you have a Feud and a Stipulation card in your Ring area. You must immediately play a Stipulation card. Choose 1 Stipulation card in your opponent's Ring area and that card is blank.

name: That Won't Make the Cut!
Text: You must discard 1 card without a printed Survivor Series logo and then put up to 3 non-Superstar-specific cards with a printed Survivor Series logo from your Ringside pile into your hand.

name: The Fabulous Moolah
Text: You cannot pack maneuvers of 3D or greater. Your Arsenal may only contain 45 cards. Once during each of your turns you may search your opponent's Arsenal for 1 card, remove it from the game, and your opponent shuffles his Arsenal.

name: The Older the Berry...
Text: You may put 1 card from your Ringside pile into your hand, 1 Backlash deck card from your Ringside pile into your Backlash deck, and 1 Backlash deck card from your Ring area into your Backlash deck.
